traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of connection and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: Something can feel beautiful and completely right while imagination is still supplying half of the story.

readerCopy.body: Something can feel beautiful and completely right while imagination is still supplying half of the story. When Venus conjoins Neptune, attraction, hope, creativity, and idealization fuse, making a person, offer, purchase, or relationship feel more complete than the known facts make it. You may be tempted to let the feeling answer questions the facts have not answered yet. Beauty can remain genuine while what is known and what has been imagined stay separate enough that a fantasy does not quietly become a contract.
